//: Lint/format config for the edge functions, which CI now typechecks and
`no-explicit-any` is excluded rather than worked around: the ledger
operations deliberately run through the caller-scoped `SupabaseClient`, and
without generated database types that client's row generic can only be
`any`. Narrowing it would mean either checking in generated types that must
then track every migration, or casting at each call site — both of which
hide the boundary instead of documenting it. RLS is the authorization
boundary here, not the TypeScript generic.
`no-import-prefix` wants bare specifiers plus an import map once this file
exists. `npm:` specifiers are the documented style for Supabase edge
functions and are what the deployed code uses; rewriting the imports of a
live function to satisfy a lint default added by its own lint config would
be the tail wagging the dog.
